title: Min positive with absence
prompt: Implement `int minPositive(int[] arr)`: the smallest value strictly greater than 0, or -1 when no positive value exists (empty arrays included). Two machines cooperate here: a sentinel for "found yet?" and an accumulator for the minimum.

tests.name: smallest positive
tests.hint: Track found with -1 sentinel; update min only for values > 0 (and first positive wins the seed).
